shots.text: It was green, kind of like light you could touch.
shots.note: The amoeba: liquid light, bloom, tendrils.

shots.text: It pulsed, slowly, like it was breathing.
shots.note: Closer: it swells and settles like breath.

shots.text: I should've run. Every instinct told me to run.
shots.note: 250 lit green from the front, frozen.

shots.text: But I just stood there, staring, because nothing in my whole life had ever looked back at me before.
shots.note: Something like an eye opens in its core and looks at him.

shots.text: It crawled up my leg like it knew exactly where it was going.
It was warm, then hot, then burning.
shots.note: The glow brightens up his body.
It slides in through a crack in his shell. Impact.

shots.text: I felt it moving through me, through every segment, rewriting something I didn't understand.
shots.note: Green veins spread segment by segment.
Slow motion: he topples onto his back.

shots.text: The dirt {impact}rushed up to meet me.
The last thing I saw was the sky,
shots.note: Looking up through giant grass; his vision closes.

shots.text: and for the first time I wondered what was up there looking back.
shots.note: Night sky; one green star pulses, watching.
